title: Workspaces and building with colcon
keywords: colcon build workspace install setup source overlay underlay symlink-install package packages-select
text: Packages are built with colcon in a workspace: src/ holds the packages, and build/, install/ and log/ are generated. After colcon build, source install/setup.bash in every new terminal (on top of /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash), otherwise the new packages, messages and plugins are not found. colcon build --packages-select pkg builds one package and --symlink-install avoids rebuilding Python and launch files. Shells sourced from different workspaces or distros are a common cause of "package not found" and type mismatch errors.
